inspiration.title: Phasmophobia
inspiration.note: The feel of collecting evidence with equipment and naming the ghost; Evidence Hunt makes it a quiet deduction puzzle with no frights, no timer and gentle outcomes.

other.title: Pyodide
other.note: Runs the game's Python rules in the browser through WebAssembly (version 0.26.4, loaded from a CDN), so the game needs no server of its own and no build step.
